scope: One test fixture repair only; production probe, original assertions, original negative controls and shared pins unchanged.

criteria.assertion: Independently reproduce the baseline 24-pass/1-fail deterministic fixture defect, preserving raw output and root-size evidence. If the environment does not reproduce, state that and qualify acceptance.
Candidate changes only assigned test path; all original test names/assertions and production probe bytes remain preserved. Additional regression coverage may be appended.

Output creation/writes must not mutate the inspected fixture tree or fabricate/normalize observed directory metadata. Repeated unchanged scans must compare actual manifests with no redaction of real differences.
Actual input mutation between scans remains observable; file contents/hashes, extra/missing entries, membership and symlink target changes must remain detectable.

Original path replacement, changed descriptor, short read, deadline, coverage, privilege/SUID/SGID/mode/ownership/hash, root/output and traversal negative controls continue failing closed as asserted.
Fixture-owned temporary roots and output directories are cleaned even on thrown assertions; no new jobs, network/provider/native binary/image operations or installs.

Independently identify direct and transitive current source packaging/hash references affected by the changed test and preserve historical evidence; do not update shared pins or claim package admission.
Run bounded meaningful local test checks against exact author freeze and preserve failures. Return ACCEPT_SOURCE or HOLD with exact source fingerprint and unresolved packaging/admission gates.
